# Event fixtures

Fixtures for tests and for building the Workspace UI (tasks.md 3.2). Each file is JSONL: `{"at": ms, "event": draft}` or `{"at": ms, "delta": {...}}`, played by `apps/server/src/dev/fixturePlayer.ts`.

| File | Source | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `synthetic-gathering-meeting.jsonl` | SYNTHETIC, generated by `scripts/fixtures/make-synthetic.ts` | Building and checking the Workspace before real runs exist. Not a recording; never shown or published as one |

| `real-linkding-success.jsonl` | REAL: the persisted events of Task `linkding-mwvnwdgv` (2026-11-25, Runtime_Rules 0.14.0, DeepSeek), one full linkding run from URL to `success`; checked for absolute paths, host, account and key strings (none found) and secret-scanned | The UI reducer, the whiteboard and the usage folding against a real run (`apps/server/src/fixtures/realRun.test.ts`); a plain event list, not the timed fixture format |

Real fixtures (sanitized spike and run outputs) are added as each stage is built: absolute paths, machine and account names are replaced, and the secret scan runs over them before commit.
